title: Because we are human
slide_intent: Anchor a section on strategy in the beliefs that guide it. Readers can understand why the design system belongs to an organization working with people.
strategic_value: The organization can connect its identity to equal human worth and access to HIV information and services.
demonstration: A photograph of a group handling containers fills the page. Two numbered beliefs appear in white, and a large boxed statement occupies the lower-right field.
practical_value: Use the beliefs as the first check when choosing a claim or photograph for the organization.
